## Bio

I'm an MA Finance student at UZH and a special student at MSc Quantitative Finance at ETH. I have had broad academic and professional experience in mathematics, finance, programming and machine learning. I focus on topics in probability theory and its various applications. I'm currently working toward a career in quantitative research. My CV can be found on a dedicated page.

This site collects several kinds of writing:

- **BA Thesis** — overview of my undergraduate thesis on applying classic market microstructure to modern decentralized markets.
- **Research Notes** — small theoretical and empirical results in pure mathematics, ML and quantitative finance that are yet to be developed into complete research papers.
- **Posts** — everything else: write-ups for coding problems, reading notes, and miscellaneous ideas.

## Research interests

- Probability theory and Stochastic processes
- Applications of ML and pure mathematics to Quantitative finance
- Statistical estimation and Decision-making under uncertainty
